messages:
Mia C.: Quick recap from the webinar + free-credit experiment — want to capture learnings and immediate fixes. TL;DR: activation rate for the cohort that received 300 credits = +18% vs control, but ~22% of webinar registrants were mis-routed and never got the SDR followup.
Jordan L.: Nice. Do we have the raw funnel numbers?
GrowthBot: automated-metric-bot: webinar_2026_03_18 registrants=1,142 clicks=734 credit_redemptions=289 activations=94 paid_conversions=11 churned_trials=3
Samir P.: From the analytics look: conversion lift concentrated in users who hit the quickstart prompt template within 24h. Quickstart engagement correlates strongly with redemption -> activation.
Emily R.: Routing bug summary: the embed form omitted the hidden input for "utm_campaign" after we swapped the script. ~250 posts came in as source=unknown, so HubSpot workflow didn’t tag them for SDR routing. I flagged a rollback earlier.
Mia C.: Ok — action items: 1) patch form to include hidden utm fields + QA. 2) backfill tags for registrants missing utm. 3) experiment iteration: test credit sizing (300 vs 600) vs onboarding nudges.
Alex G.: For the backfill — can we rely on email domain heuristics to assign region/SAM? or do we need to ping registrants?
Emily R.: We can populate UTM via query-string replay for ~70% of affected entries, then the rest get manual. I'll draft the backfill playbook.
Jordan L.: On experiment framing: instead of credit size only, we should test nudge timing — immediate in-product nudge vs email drip at 12h. Hypothesis: immediate nudge increases short-term activation but may reduce perceived value.
Samir P.: Agree. Also want to run a small holdout for prompt-template variants: "starter prompts" vs "industry-specific templates". Metric: 24h completion -> redeem -> prompt-run count.
Mia C.: Can design own funnel matrix: credit_size x nudge_timing x prompt_template. Practical constraints: we can run 2x2 at a time to avoid combinatorial explosion.
GrowthBot: experiment-suggester: based on current throughput you can run up to 4 concurrent micro-experiments for cohorts ~200 each.
Jordan L.: Budget question: cost of 600-credit arm ~ $X per cohort — who owns budget sign-off?
Alex G.: I'll coordinate with finance, should be fine for two microtests. Will confirm by EOD.
Emily R.: Quick checklist for patching routing:
```
- Add hidden inputs: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign
- Update embed script to preserve query params
- Deploy to prod after QA on staging form
- Run backfill job script to update HubSpot for missing UTMs
```
Mia C.: Nice. For messaging iteration, we should update the post-webinar email copy to include a clear CTA: "Redeem your starter credits + try templates" with one-click deep link to in-product quickstart. Drafts: I'll post two variants later.
Samir P.: Data ask: can analytics team break out redemption -> paid conversion by source (organic/referral/webinar) for past 90 days? That will help LTV estimate per credit.
GrowthBot: task-created: analytics_request_1782 — owners: Samir P., DataTeam.ETA: 72h.
Jordan L.: One more thing: inbound lead routing — for any registrant labeled source=unknown we should trigger a 48h automated email nudging them to redeem credits, and flag for SDR if they click the deep link. That recovers some missed routing.
Emily R.: I'll add that as a fallback workflow in HubSpot.
Mia C.: Who will own the experiment plan doc? Need CRO, ops, and data owners listed.
Alex G.: I'll create a short experiment brief in Notion and assign owners. Link will be in this thread when ready.
Samir P.: Postmortem item: update the embed QA checklist to include UTM preservation test and load test for form script.
Mia C.: Perfect. I'll summarize action items and owners shortly:
- Emily: patch & backfill (owner)
- Alex: finance sign-off + Notion brief (owner)
- Jordan: experiment design (nudge timing)
- Samir: analytics & LTV estimates
- Mia: messaging drafts + webinar follow email variants

Mia C.: Thanks everyone — small win on activation, but routing issue cost lead quality. We should be able to recover most with the backfill + fallback nudge. Will follow up with the Notion link and schedule 15m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
